value.account:
Added pure projection-owned identity and loop-progress validation, stable privacy-preserving diagnostics, typed Workflow Lisp retry indexing, and deterministic retry allocation. Integrated audits before root resume mutation and after reached-call checksum/input validation, preserving callee state on rejection and promoting the unchanged diagnostic through ancestors. Added atomic three-field failure envelopes, non-routable failures across routes and loops, supplemental finalization failures, and forensic pending status/heartbeat behavior. Classic YAML duplicate import ownership now rejects before bundle construction with original source positions. Compiler/imported bundles retain typed provenance and lowering-route context; CLI preserves that structured metadata. Updated the state contract, acceptance entries, affected fixtures and narrowly changed projection goldens.

Kept scope-local audits rather than eager recursive execution checks so checksum and bound-input failures retain their required precedence. Discarded name/suffix/mapping-order selection and identity repair because they cannot establish exact current ownership. Added no dependency, schema upgrade, migration evidence, or persisted audit data.

Verification: 959 affected tests passed with 16 workers; all 94 new tests collected; 8 targeted adjudication resume checks and the reusable-call resume smoke passed; demo CLI dry-run and diff checks passed. The last full suite reported 4814 passed, 13 skipped and 48 failures. Representative failures reproduced with original implementations; remaining issues include unavailable pilot/inventory/nanoBragg assets, existing workflow/provider/golden mismatches, and timing/shared-temp failures. I did not repair those unrelated issues or run live external providers/hardware.
value.summary: Implemented fail-closed checksum-compatible resume with exact scope audits, deterministic retry lineage, and sticky private diagnostics.
